title: docs(app-crm): point two stale approval comments at the real consumers
body:
Fixes #14516

Two comments in `examples/app-crm` named a **"Discount Approval" flow that this app does not contain**. These examples are copy-source for AI authors, so a comment naming an absent flow teaches a false shape. This PR rewrites both comments to name what is actually in the tree. **Comment-only** — no declaration, expression, or export changed.

## Scope

Resolution 1 of the card only, per the triage ruling on the issue.

- **Resolution 2** (add a Discount Approval flow to the CRM) is a feature, and it argues against `src/flows/index.ts`'s stated one-flow scope. Out of scope here.
- **Resolution 3** (delete `FinanceApproverPosition` as an unreferenced declaration) rests on a false premise and is **not** acted on. The position is live scaffolding with a real consumer; deleting it would break `objectstack.config.ts` and the permission-set binding. Fence proof below.

## Site 1 — `examples/app-crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts`

**Before:**

```ts
    // Mirror target for the Discount Approval flow's approval nodes
    // (ADR-0019). The approval runtime writes the request status here; it is
    // readonly to users so only the flow drives it.
```

**After:**

```ts
    // Mirror target for an approval node's `approvalStatusField` (ADR-0019):
    // the approval runtime writes the request status here, so it stays
    // readonly to users. This app declares no approval flow of its own — the
    // CRM keeps one flow on purpose (src/flows/index.ts); the worked approval
    // flows are examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/, and the
    // `approvalStatusField` wiring is shown in skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md.
```

Why: `examples/app-crm/src/flows/` holds only `convert-lead.flow.ts` and `index.ts`, and `flows/index.ts` states the split deliberately — *"Automation breadth (approvals, schedules, connectors, subflows, …) is the showcase's job"*. The mechanism the field serves is real and is now named: an approval node's `approvalStatusField` config key (ADR-0019; `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` reads it into `mirrorField`). The worked approval flows are in `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/`, and the `approvalStatusField: 'approval_status'` wiring is spelled out in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`.

## Site 2 — `examples/app-crm/src/security/sales-positions.ts`

**Before:**

```ts
/** Referenced by the Discount Approval second step. */
```

**After:**

```ts
/**
 * Registered in `objectstack.config.ts` (`positions`) and bound to the
 * `crm_sales_user` permission set by `bind-position-sets.ts`, alongside
 * `sales_rep` and `sales_manager`. This app models no approval flow; the
 * worked approval flows live in `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/`.
 */
```

Why: there is no "Discount Approval second step" anywhere in the repo. The comment now names the position's actual consumers.

## Fence — `FinanceApproverPosition` is still referenced

`git grep -n "FinanceApproverPosition" HEAD -- examples/app-crm` on the branch head:

```
examples/app-crm/objectstack.config.ts:17:  FinanceApproverPosition,
examples/app-crm/objectstack.config.ts:100:  positions: [SalesRepPosition, SalesManagerPosition, FinanceApproverPosition],
examples/app-crm/src/security/index.ts:6:  FinanceApproverPosition,
examples/app-crm/src/security/sales-positions.ts:28:export const FinanceApproverPosition = definePosition({
```

`git grep -n "finance_approver" HEAD -- examples/app-crm/src/security/bind-position-sets.ts`:

```
examples/app-crm/src/security/bind-position-sets.ts:10: * (`sales_rep`, `sales_manager`, `finance_approver`) and a `crm_sales_user`
examples/app-crm/src/security/bind-position-sets.ts:33:  ['finance_approver', 'crm_sales_user'],
```

Import, registration and binding are all intact — nothing was removed.

## Comment-only proof

Two independent measurements, both zero-difference:

1. **Diff line filter.** Of the 16 changed lines in `git diff BASE..HEAD` (BASE `2d40f9146`), the count of changed lines that are not comment or blank lines is **0**.
2. **Token-stream equality.** Both files were tokenised with the repo's own TypeScript (`ts.createScanner`, `skipTrivia: true`) at BASE and at HEAD:

```
opportunity.object.ts: base tokens=605 head tokens=605 identical=true
sales-positions.ts:    base tokens=266 head tokens=266 identical=true
RESULT: comment-only (non-trivia token streams identical)
```

## Verification — at branch head `94d444d87`

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/example-crm^...' build` | `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) | `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-crm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` | `Test Files 5 passed (5)` · `Tests 45 passed (45)` |
| `pnpm check:nul-bytes` | `OK (scanned 8070 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)` |

**Gate family** re-derived from the real diff with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (2 paths vs merge base `2d40f9146`) — 15 families, all run:

- 13 green: `check-comment-mask-adoption`, `check-cross-package-test-inputs`, `check-keyed-text-bounds`, `check-position-name-fold-loaders`, `check-shard-attestation`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:examples-live-imports`, `check:logger-receiver-detach`, `check:page-declaration-shape`, `check:published-files`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-source-resolution`.
- 2 **NOT MEASURED** locally, by each gate's own verdict text, neither a red: `check-test-completeness` exits 3 saying *"There is no local log to hand it, so the local reading for this gate is NOT MEASURED. ⛔ It is not a red"*; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 with *"PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/ … ⛔ This is NOT a pass: nothing was measured"* (it needs a full `pnpm build`; CI builds everything). Neither reads any file in this diff.

**ESLint — declared narrowing.** `pnpm lint` (repo-wide `eslint . --no-inline-config`) was narrowed to the two changed files, with the narrowing measured rather than assumed:

- Population: eslint's own config resolution accepted both paths (neither ignored), `--format json` reports **2 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings**, exit 0.
- Invariance for untouched files: this repo runs one `eslint.config.mjs` which, in its own words at line 328, *"never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file, test or not"* — so a two-file comment-only diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. CI runs the full sweep regardless.

## Changeset

None, and `skip-changeset` is applied: the diff is comment-only inside `examples/app-crm`, which is `"private": true` and publishes nothing.
